verses.18:95: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِيهِ رَبِّي خَيۡرࣱ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًا

meaning: The root ردم (rdm) primarily means to stop up or close something, like a gap or entrance, often by piling things up. It can also refer to patching clothes or making a bow twang.
